decisions.reason: After appearing on its own page in 2018 and 2019 but not thereafter, this close-to-core CD looks to have revealed limited continuing demand, so its option value is largely exhausted and shelf, inventory, and curation resources are better redeployed.

The illustrated release series was visible in 2018 and 2019 but not later, suggesting the market test has largely played out and the firm should stop committing attention to a niche line without clear ongoing traction.

A single-year appearance for this jazz vinyl reissue points to weak evidence of durable sales beyond the initial test, so keeping the option open no longer seems worth the carrying and assortment costs.

Because the multi-disc box set was shown only in its launch year, uncertainty about its prospects appears sufficiently resolved and the firm should release capital tied up in a costly specialist format.

This compilation CD received only a brief website mention in 2019, which is too little support to justify further commitment when the firm can use the resources for stronger core releases or new experiments.
